svg.title: The 24 solar terms
svg.desc: The year divided into 24 solar terms at 15-degree steps of the Sun’s longitude, starting with risshun (beginning of spring, about 4 February, 315 degrees), through shunbun (spring equinox, 21 March, 0 degrees), geshi (summer solstice, 21 June), shūbun (autumn equinox, 23 September, 180 degrees) and tōji (winter solstice, 21 December), to daikan (great cold, 21 January).
svg.text: Dates are approximate and move by about a day from year to year.
